name: The Coffee Shot
source: Brand dossier (coffee-shot/kit), Google Maps & Places 19 Nov 2026
colors_note: Sampled from the official logo file and photos. Approximate, not an official palette.
logo: Closed circular seal: black bottle-cap ring with white ticks, thin gold rule, white field, 'THE COFFEE' arched on top and 'SHOT' at the base in a gold classic serif, an espresso shot glass with a coffee bean and three curls of steam between double black rules. Facade variant: cream rectangular panel with a double gold rule and the name in serif caps.
logo_file: kit/the-coffee-shot-logo-OFFICIAL-400.png (real file, from their gift-card shop on me2you.ie; ask for the vector)
cup_line: Speciality coffees & teas freshly made to order
usp_quote: Sandyford's newest coffee establishment. Our USP – we love coffee, are serious about coffee and have sourced the best beans to make it.
voice: The owner talking from behind the counter: warm, grateful, signs off with trailing dots ('As Ever......').

suppliers.detail: Red Rock Espresso Blend (still current? to confirm)

quotes.text: Mark seems to know everyone's name and order, as does Jiri.
A little gem… everything from the coffee to the crisps has been thoughtfully and carefully sourced.
